en.question: Which statement about the system parameter is correct?

options.text: It is supplied as a message with role "system" inside the messages array.
options.note: There is no system role within the messages array in this API.

options.text: It is a top-level request parameter, separate from the messages array.
It must be repeated inside each user message in order to remain in effect.
options.note: It applies to the whole request, so repeating it only wastes tokens.

options.text: It becomes available only on requests that also define one or more tools.
options.note: It is always available and is independent of tool use.

en.explanation: The messages array contains only user and assistant turns. Placing a "system" role inside it is a common error that produces a 400.
